title: Hold a regular passenger transport service authorisation
what: Hold a regular passenger transport service authorisation before providing a regular (bus) passenger service.

sources.title: Transport (Road Passenger Services) Act 2018 (WA)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if — (a) the person provides a regular passenger transport service; and (b) the person does not hold a regular passenger transport service authorisation that is in force and authorises the provision of that service.
